Meta.title: Beneficiary Designation Form | Nossa Seguros
Meta.description: Digital form for beneficiary designation of Nossa Seguros' Individual Life Insurance policy.

fields.emailHint: We'll send a copy of the form to this address.

declaration.outro: , acknowledge that I have been informed of the Terms and Conditions of the Individual Life Insurance Policy.
declaration.deathClause: I am aware that in the event of Death the Insured Capital will be paid to the beneficiary(ies) declared below.
declaration.confirmation: I confirm that the beneficiary(ies) of this Policy is/are the following:

consent.updateNotice: I am aware that I must update this form whenever necessary and submit it to NOSSA.
consent.dataProcessing: I authorise the data collected in this document, as well as in any other documents to be provided later — namely upon claim submission — to be processed and stored electronically for the purposes of managing the Individual Life Insurance Policy, including disclosure to other companies (in particular within the group, subcontractors and reinsurers), which may involve transferring information to other countries, as well as for direct marketing purposes.
consent.integralPart: I agree that this confirmation forms an integral part of the Policy.
consent.agree: I have read and agree with the declarations and authorisations.

confirmation.modalIntro: By clicking "Accept and Submit", you declare that:
modalBullets: You have read and accept the terms and conditions of the Individual Life Insurance Policy.
You authorise the processing of your data as described in the form.
You confirm that the beneficiaries listed are the intended ones.
This digital acceptance has the same effect as a handwritten signature.

validation.invalidNif: Invalid Tax ID (must have 9 to 14 digits)
validation.atLeastOneBeneficiary: Please add at least one beneficiary
validation.agreeRequired: You must accept the declarations to submit

Success.title: Form submitted successfully
